surface: Private Octane core-editor adapter with two retained React-port context/hook files; MIT-only publication is blocked on provenance review.
divergences: The package integrates @blocknote/core directly and does not claim the full @blocknote/react public surface.
Floating toolbars, menus, schema renderers, and other UI are application-owned children rather than bundled React UI.
Refs are ordinary Octane props; no forwardRef layer exists.
ssr: BlockNoteView renders its container during SSR and mounts the core editor from an isomorphic layout effect on the client. useCreateBlockNote is a client-side editor hook.
notes: Runtime and public-type tests pass; this is not license approval or full upstream parity verification.

BlockNoteContext.ts and useBlockNoteEditor.ts retain mechanical-port provenance. The package is private until an independently authored replacement or approved upstream-license distribution resolves this boundary.
